audit.whatIsWrong: Brittle is attributed to the wrong abilities throughout: wants.foe[0] says Volcanic Rupture applies it, wants.foe[1] calls Bellows Breath a passive that Brittles 'every auto', and early talks about 'auto-Brittle stacks'. The combo is also described as an E wall-shove rather than a charge into his own pillar.
audit.why: Bellows Breath (W, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10) is an active — only enemies hit by the FINAL gout of flame become Brittle. Volcanic Rupture (Q, 9/8.5/8/7.5/7, 800 range) slows and leaves a magma pillar, which is terrain. Searing Charge (E, 14/13.5/13/12.5/12, 450 range) only knocks up if Ornn collides with terrain — his own pillar counts, so he does not need a lane wall.
audit.corrected: Brittle credited to Bellows Breath's final gout everywhere; the combo restated as pillar-then-charge-into-terrain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Skill, Skill, Ornn, Ornn in both layers.
audit.why: The mirror (ornn__sion) is already set to Level 2 Skill, Levels 4-5 Ornn, Level 6 Ornn, 2+ items Skill, and the packet chart matches it exactly. Level 2 predates his pillar-and-charge delivery; levels 4-6 are his peak; two items is where a Heartsteel HP total closes the gap.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 3, 4 and 6 flipped as matched pairs in both layers, row 6 rating raised to follow.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] claimed Searing Charge 'refreshes quickly' and the level 6 spike gave no ultimate cooldown.
audit.why: Searing Charge is 14 seconds at rank 1 — the longest cooldown in his lane kit and the single spell your all-in waits on. Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100.
audit.corrected: Real numbers now in whys[3], whys[4], spikes[1] and mid.

edits.before: Ornn's Bellows Breath is online but his Searing Charge wall delivery is still telegraphable without a nearby wall — W-shield his autos freely, but hold your charged Q until his E is committed.
edits.after: Bellows Breath is online — its final gout is what makes you Brittle, not his autos — but without a pillar his Searing Charge has nothing to slam you into; hold Q until E is committed.

edits.before: His full Q pillar into E wall-shove into Brittle proc combo is live — he controls when and how the trade starts, so fight center-lane or accept that he controls this window.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture's pillar into a Searing Charge knockup into a Brittle gout is live — he picks when the trade starts, so fight centre-lane away from terrain.

edits.before: Q on short cooldown and Searing Charge refreshing quickly makes him the trade initiator all laning phase — play for W-shield value and CS; never charge Q near the walls at this stage.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture is a 9s cooldown and Searing Charge 14s, so he still picks the trades — play for Soul Furnace value and CS, and never charge Q near a wall or a fresh pillar.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God delivers a double-knockup after a Brittle proc and can confirm a kill on you at half HP — play at wave, keep HP up, and only all-in if his R is recently used.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God (140s at rank 1) makes you Brittle itself and he can recast to slam the elemental back through you — play at the wave, keep your HP up, and only all-in once it has been spent.

edits.before: Ornn's Volcanic Rupture into Searing Charge knockup is his strongest trading window — he shoves you into the wall and procs Brittle before you can land a charge.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture's pillar plus a Searing Charge knockup is his best window — he charges into terrain, knocks you up, and Bellows Breath makes you Brittle.

edits.before: Ornn's Call of the Forge God gives him a second knockup after the Brittle proc, letting him confirm kills if you are below half HP — respect it and play at wave rather than tower.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God (140s at rank 1) slows and Brittles anyone it runs over, and he can recast to redirect it — respect it and play at the wave, not under the tower.

edits.before: At Level 1 and 2 neither of you has a meaningful combo — Ornn has his Q pillar poke and auto-Brittle stacks but no wall shove yet, so short W-shield trades are even. Play at max auto range, use your W-shield to eat one auto-Brittle stack and shove it back, and never charge Q in the open at this stage because his Q pillar will stagger your channel and you will net nothing. At Level 3 his kit is fully online: Volcanic Rupture plants the pillar, Searing Charge shoves you into it, and one Bellows Breath auto triggers Brittle for a punishing burst sequence. Your charged Q is too slow to preempt this — he initiates it, not you. Stay near the center of the lane away from both walls, and save your W-shield for the Searing Charge landing.
edits.after: At Level 1 and 2 neither of you has a meaningful combo — Ornn has his Q pillar poke but no pillar-and-charge delivery yet, so short W-shield trades are even. Play at max auto range, use your W-shield to eat one Bellows Breath gout and shove it back, and never charge Q in the open at this stage because his Q slow will stagger your approach and you will net nothing. At Level 3 his kit is fully online: Volcanic Rupture plants the pillar, Searing Charge slams into it for the knockup, and the final gout of Bellows Breath makes you Brittle for the burst. Your charged Q is too slow to preempt this — he initiates it, not you. Stay near the centre of the lane away from both walls and any fresh pillar, and save your W-shield for the Searing Charge landing.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 6 are Ornn's best stretch. His Q-E-auto Brittle combo is on short cooldowns, he self-upgrades his first item into an enhanced version that outpaces your own durability climb, and his Level 6 Call of the Forge God adds a second knockup that can confirm any all-in. Your job here is survival and HP stacking: W-shield every Brittle proc combo, keep the wave near river so you have backing room, and never brawl him at half HP once his R is available. Your charged Q can land if you bait out his Searing Charge first — once E is down he has no wall-shove delivery for the full Brittle sequence and you can punish with Q-stun into E armor-shred. But this window is short; respect his power and take the small trades, not the all-in.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 6 are Ornn's best stretch. His pillar-into-charge combo is on short cooldowns, he self-upgrades his first item into an enhanced version that outpaces your own durability climb, and his Level 6 Call of the Forge God adds a displacement that can confirm any all-in. Your job here is survival and HP stacking: W-shield every Brittle sequence, keep the wave near river so you have backing room, and never brawl him at half HP once his R is available. Your charged Q can land if you bait out Searing Charge first — it is 14 seconds at rank 1, and without it he has no delivery into his own pillar, so punish with Q-stun into E armour-shred. But this window is short; take the small trades, not the all-in.

edits.before: Land Volcanic Rupture (Q pillar) to apply Brittle and set up the Searing Charge wall-knockup for a confirmed proc
edits.after: Plant a Volcanic Rupture pillar, then Searing Charge into it so the knockup lands where you cannot walk out

edits.before: Use Bellows Breath (W) passive Brittle on every auto to lower the threshold for his E-Q combo
edits.after: Catch you in the final gout of Bellows Breath so you are Brittle for the follow-up burst

edits.before: Call of the Forge God (R) double-knockup after a Brittle proc to confirm all-in kills and deny your escape window
edits.after: Run Call of the Forge God through you for the slow and Brittle, then recast it to cut off any clean escape
